changelog: Fixes a control-page bug after Factory Reset: the page previously stayed showing disabled buttons (including "Check for Firmware Update") after the device rebooted and the browser tab silently reconnected, requiring a manual page refresh to recover. The page now reloads itself automatically once it detects a genuine reconnect following a factory reset. Also includes all v0.15.1 changes (firmware-update status-reporting race fix) and v0.15.0 changes (Clock tab order, WiFi-required prompts, auto-connect toggle fix, hotspot-IP reconnect warning, WiFi networks list rename).
